privateEvents.link.newLinkHelp: Use this if the link went somewhere it should not. The current link will stop working right away, and printed QR codes will stop too.
privateEvents.link.newLinkFailed: Could not make a new link.
privateEvents.link.offNotice: Ordering by private link is off for this event, so there is no link to share. The event will still appear on your schedule as “Private event”.
privateEvents.cards.blurb: Order and pay on your phone. We will call your name when it is ready.
privateEvents.noSinglePost: Private events do not get their own post — they appear on your weekly poster as “Private event”.
privateEvents.confirmToPrivate: This will hide the address and the event from the map. Guests will need the private link to order.
privateEvents.confirmFromPrivate: This will make the event public: its address and map pin will show, and the private link will stop working.
